 * Setup default environment, logging (logback or log4j2) and run application.
 *
 * @param args
 * 		Application arguments.
 * @param server
 * 		Server.
 * @param provider
 * 		Application provider.
 */
public static void runApp(@NonNull
String[] args, @NonNull
Server server, @NonNull
List<Supplier<Jooby>> provider) // PATH: Test should invoke the next Jooby.runApp(...) [step in execution path]
{
    Jooby.runApp(args, server, ExecutionMode.DEFAULT, provider);
}
